description: This Java class 'HtmlWidget' is part of the OFBiz widget model, responsible for rendering HTML templates, including support for FreeMarker templates, HTML decoration, and script extraction. It defines nested classes for template handling, decoration, and rendering logic, and manages sub-widgets within an HTML widget structure.

classes.name: ExtendedWrapper
classes.description: Custom BeansWrapper for FreeMarker to handle String and Collection encoding for HTML.

classes.name: StringHtmlWrapperForFtl
classes.description: Wrapper for String objects to encode for HTML in FreeMarker templates.

classes.name: CollectionHtmlWrapperForFtl
classes.description: Wrapper for Collections to encode for HTML in FreeMarker templates.

classes.name: HtmlTemplate
classes.description: Represents an HTML template, supporting inline FTL and external template files, with multi-block support.

classes.name: HtmlTemplateDecorator
classes.description: Decorator for HTML templates, allowing sections to be defined and rendered separately.

classes.name: HtmlTemplateDecoratorSection
classes.description: Represents a section within an HTML template decorator, containing sub-widgets.

methods.name: renderHtmlTemplate
methods.description: Renders a FreeMarker template or throws an error if unsupported.

methods.name: writeError
methods.description: Outputs an error message to the writer.
